description:
3DCodeVerse — Towards Building the Universe via Code
	

3DCodeVerse aims to gather any code that creates, renders, or governs 3D — every dialect, one corpus.
Text / Image / Video   ↔   3D Code   ↔   3D Assets

Every entry is a self-contained, runnable project: the code, its rendered outputs, a metadata card, and text captions. Domains in scope: Object Modeling · Scene & World Modeling · Rendering · Materials & Shaders · Physics & Simulation · Animation & Articulation.
